data.name: LaunchFailedText
data.value: connect.exe was started, but the game did not appear. Common causes: an antivirus blocked connect.exe (it modifies the game process in memory), .NET Framework 4 is missing, or the client folder is incomplete. Copy the support info and ask on Discord.

data.name: AboutCredits
data.value: Artwork: Nostalgia art set (original work). The launcher only uses an existing client installation and does not change any game files.

data.name: PrivacyText
data.value:
What the server stores: your Discord ID and your account name (linked by the Discord bot, one account per Discord user), the password only as a hash, plus the usual game data (characters, login times, IP address at login).
What the launcher stores on this PC ({0}): • login.dat – account name and password, encrypted by Windows (DPAPI, only your Windows account can read it). “Switch account / sign out” deletes the file. • settings.json – client folder, notices you have read. • manifest-cache.json – server address and news. • logs – logs of the last days, without the password.
The launcher sends nothing except: fetching the manifest (GitHub), the status check of the login port, and update downloads. When the game starts, the client receives account name and password as start parameters (visible to other programs of your Windows account).
